question_or_proposition: Whether, for Outfall 001, the Flow row in Part I Section A designates flow as report-only MGD reporting with continuous totalizing-meter monitoring and without enforceable numeric effluent limits subject to exceedance comparison.
required_context: Part I Section A effluent limitations table column headers for mass/load limits (30-DAY AVG, DAILY MAX, 7-DAY AVG) and concentration limits (30-DAY AVG, DAILY MAX, 7-DAY AVG)
Part I authorization language requiring discharges from Outfall 001 to be limited and monitored as specified in the table
notes: The nominated Flow row pairs Report MGD limit-column entries with *** concentration columns and specifies Continuous measurement via Totalizing Meter. How this row is read affects whether flow is an enforceable numeric limit (A), whether continuous flow monitoring was required (B), and how absent flow evidence is categorized relative to report-only versus required monitoring (C).
